newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: DODGE CITY, July 17 (Reuder) - Trade was moderate and
slaughter steers and heifers steady with Tuesday, USDA said.
Wk to date - 76,600 Last week - 79,800 Last year - 14,200
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1260 lbs
64.00, couple pens 63.50; pen 1250 lb Holsteins 57.00. Dressed
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1175 lbs 64.00, pen 63.50; few mixed Commercial and Choice 1140-1200 lb heifers and heiferettes 62.00-63.00.

Inquiry and demand was good. Sales confirmed on 9,200 slaughter steers and 10,300 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 76,600 head confirmed including 22,400 head or about 29 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
